findings.title: Prometheus scrapes only 3 targets; nearly all `falcon_*` signals hinge on the node-exporter textfile collector
findings.recommendation: Scrape OpenSearch/ntfy/relay directly and/or alert on the collector freshness so signal loss is visible.
findings.detail: Scrape OpenSearch/ntfy/relay directly and/or alert on the collector freshness so signal loss is visible.

findings.title: Cross-repo pairing contract cannot be verified in this environment
findings.recommendation: Vendor the edge pin + verifier inputs so the pairing contract verifies from a clean clone.
findings.detail: Vendor the edge pin + verifier inputs so the pairing contract verifies from a clean clone.

findings.title: Single-host concentration: host loss is total pipeline loss
findings.recommendation: Add a warm standby or a documented, tested RTO/RPO acceptance with owner sign-off.
findings.detail: Add a warm standby or a documented, tested RTO/RPO acceptance with owner sign-off.

findings.title: Branch protection and required checks are plan-gated and unenforceable server-side
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to GitHub Pro/Team and apply the ready payload, or record per-merge validate attestation.
findings.detail: Upgrade to GitHub Pro/Team and apply the ready payload, or record per-merge validate attestation.

findings.title: Branch protection and required checks are not enforced server-side
findings.recommendation: Upgrade the plan and apply the ready payload, or record a per-merge attestation.
findings.detail: Upgrade the plan and apply the ready payload, or record a per-merge attestation.

findings.title: Wazuh and IRIS data have no retention (unbounded index growth)
findings.recommendation: Owner decision + apply ISM/ILM retention for Wazuh and IRIS indices, then record the policy id.
findings.detail: Owner decision + apply ISM/ILM retention for Wazuh and IRIS indices, then record the policy id.

findings.title: Operational resilience remains incomplete across the backup lifecycle
findings.recommendation: Close the offsite/dead-man residuals and add an end-to-end restore assertion to the gate.
findings.detail: Close the offsite/dead-man residuals and add an end-to-end restore assertion to the gate.

findings.title: Committed `review-package/` is a stale snapshot duplicate of the source tree
findings.recommendation: Stop committing the generated package or rebuild+rebind it and gate content drift.
findings.detail: Stop committing the generated package or rebuild+rebind it and gate content drift.

findings.title: Admin/observability consoles are exposed through public routers without origin authentication
findings.recommendation: Put admin consoles behind Cloudflare Access or an auth middleware and remove anonymous routes.
findings.detail: Put admin consoles behind Cloudflare Access or an auth middleware and remove anonymous routes.

findings.title: Ingest contract relies on a shared secret header, not request signing or idempotency keys
findings.recommendation: Add request signing / idempotency keys to the vector ingest contract.
findings.detail: Add request signing / idempotency keys to the vector ingest contract.

findings.title: Declared container hardening lags the running containers
findings.recommendation: Bring declared security_opt/read_only/cap_drop in compose to parity with live and gate it.
findings.detail: Bring declared security_opt/read_only/cap_drop in compose to parity with live and gate it.

findings.title: Wazuh and vendored MCT stacks run tag-only images outside pin/SBOM scope
findings.recommendation: Extend pins/images.lock + SBOM coverage to Wazuh/MCT or scope the waiver per ref.
findings.detail: Extend pins/images.lock + SBOM coverage to Wazuh/MCT or scope the waiver per ref.

findings.title: Live ingest authentication is a shared secret header, not mTLS
findings.recommendation: Move edge→aggregator ingest to certificate/mTLS identity or add request signing + idempotency.
findings.detail: Move edge→aggregator ingest to certificate/mTLS identity or add request signing + idempotency.

findings.title: Auto-merge workflow holds `contents: write` with no environment protection
findings.recommendation: Scope permissions to minimum and add --match-head-commit to the merge command.
findings.detail: Scope permissions to minimum and add --match-head-commit to the merge command.

findings.title: Vendored MCT services are present in Compose while the subtree policy calls the tree archive-only
findings.recommendation: Make the vendored tree non-deployable (separate profile) or drop the archive-only claim.
findings.detail: Make the vendored tree non-deployable (separate profile) or drop the archive-only claim.

findings.title: Large generated SBOM/vulnerability JSON committed (39 files, up to ~122 KB each)
findings.recommendation: Move generated SBOM/vuln JSON to release artifacts or compress and gate regeneration.
findings.detail: Move generated SBOM/vuln JSON to release artifacts or compress and gate regeneration.

findings.title: Generated/derived trees are not bound to HEAD by an automated drift gate
findings.recommendation: Add a generated-drift gate for review-package/sbom/closeout or record the deferral as an owner decision.
findings.detail: Add a generated-drift gate for review-package/sbom/closeout or record the deferral as an owner decision.

findings.title: Repository is majority generated/derived content with no in-repo regeneration or drift check
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the derived trees and bind them to HEAD in CI; the review-package rebind is the open half.
findings.detail: Regenerate the derived trees and bind them to HEAD in CI; the review-package rebind is the open half.

findings.title: Public ntfy routers lack origin authentication; `ntfy-auth` middleware is not wired
findings.recommendation: Wire the ntfy auth middleware or gate the public route behind Cloudflare Access.
findings.detail: Wire the ntfy auth middleware or gate the public route behind Cloudflare Access.

findings.title: Release/SBOM artifacts are integrity-checked but unsigned; image/SBOM license gate not enforced
findings.recommendation: Sign sbom/SBOM_MANIFEST.sha256 (ed25519/GPG or GitHub attestations) and enforce a license allow/deny gate.
findings.detail: Sign sbom/SBOM_MANIFEST.sha256 (ed25519/GPG or GitHub attestations) and enforce a license allow/deny gate.

findings.title: Search/index retention is enforced only for falcon-eve; Wazuh/IRIS indices grow unbounded
findings.recommendation: Apply retention policies to Wazuh/IRIS indices and add a metrics check for unmanaged indices.
findings.detail: Apply retention policies to Wazuh/IRIS indices and add a metrics check for unmanaged indices.

findings.title: Public-facing routers have no origin authentication; `ntfy-auth` is dead config
findings.recommendation: Wire the ntfy/Traefik auth middleware or document the origin-trust decision explicitly.
findings.detail: Wire the ntfy/Traefik auth middleware or document the origin-trust decision explicitly.

findings.title: Inherited credential estate is still pending rotation and 28 vendored scripts source credential files wholesale
findings.recommendation: Execute the rotation order with name-only evidence; migrate vendored scripts to the single-key reader.
findings.detail: Execute the rotation order with name-only evidence; migrate vendored scripts to the single-key reader.

findings.title: No consolidated access-control matrix; authorization is per-service basic-auth / console accounts
findings.recommendation: Publish an access-control matrix mapping services→roles→auth mechanism and review it each patch window.
findings.detail: Publish an access-control matrix mapping services→roles→auth mechanism and review it each patch window.

findings.title: Chained path: anonymous public router → admin console abuse, plus docker.sock in vendored compose
findings.recommendation: Break the chain at origin auth (Cloudflare Access) and remove docker.sock from the vendored stack.
findings.detail: Break the chain at origin auth (Cloudflare Access) and remove docker.sock from the vendored stack.

findings.title: Vendored MCT compose mounts docker.sock and uses floating tags under a blanket waiver
findings.recommendation: Remove/justify docker.sock mounts, pin by digest, and scope the waiver per ref.
findings.detail: Remove/justify docker.sock mounts, pin by digest, and scope the waiver per ref.

findings.title: [GIT] No LICENSE file
findings.detail: Add a LICENSE or an explicit proprietary review-only notice consistent with the owner decision.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] 58 container image(s) without a digest pin
findings.detail: Pin images by digest (image@sha256:...) for reproducible, tamper-evident deploys, or scope the waiver per ref.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] hadolint not available on the check runner (Dockerfile lint skipped)
findings.detail: Install hadolint in the deterministic CI job so Dockerfile lint is not a coverage gap.

findings.title: [DEP] trivy not available on the check runner (dependency vuln scan skipped)
findings.detail: Install trivy in the deterministic CI job so dependency/image scanning is enforced, not skipped.

findings.title: Offsite/dead-man residuals remain owner-side; no scheduled restore assertion in CI
findings.recommendation: Schedule an end-to-end restore assertion and close the DO-side dead-man residual.
findings.detail: Schedule an end-to-end restore assertion and close the DO-side dead-man residual.

findings.title: Legacy host-absolute evidence paths require manual rewrite to resolve in a clone
findings.recommendation: Finish the evidence-index path normalization so every recorded path resolves in a clean clone.
findings.detail: Finish the evidence-index path normalization so every recorded path resolves in a clean clone.

findings.title: No root CHANGELOG/release-notes generator; release notes live only in mct/
findings.recommendation: Add a root CHANGELOG/release-notes generator fed from the gate/decision ledgers.
findings.detail: Add a root CHANGELOG/release-notes generator fed from the gate/decision ledgers.

findings.title: Webhook/relay delivery has no replay/idempotency evidence for Shuffle and ntfy paths
findings.recommendation: Add replay/idempotency tests (duplicate delivery, out-of-order) for the Shuffle and ntfy paths.
findings.detail: Add replay/idempotency tests (duplicate delivery, out-of-order) for the Shuffle and ntfy paths.
